start = Int('start')  # minutes from 00:00

# Domain constraints
s.add(day >= 0, day <= 2)
s.add(start >= work_start, start + meeting_len <= work_end)

def add_busy(day_val, busy_intervals):

        s.add(Or(start + meeting_len <= b_start, start >= b_end))
